global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth with tender chashu pork and crisp nori. Topped with menma and a pink “e” fish cake, it sits in a white bowl on a wooden table, warmly lit to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and smooth texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles with visible green onions and a pink flower-shaped garnish.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible speckles.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice, pale pink, tender texture, irregular shape, speckled with dark sesame seeds on surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale tan, slightly glossy, with a cylindrical shape and faint speckles on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, scalloped-edged, with pink 'e' swirl on smooth surface.
